get.description: Backlog per lane and the failed jobs. Shows no job arguments, so no learner data.

post.description:
Queue a failed job again, with fresh attempts. A job is retried once; a second
retry of the same job answers 404 `job_not_found`.

404.description: Not an administrator (`not_found`), or no failed job with this id waits for a retry (`job_not_found`)

409.description: The same work is already queued (`job_already_queued`)

get.description: Content-free daily usage for the last 30 UTC dates and current quota consumption.
The document versions a learner accepts now, for the sign-up form (#104).

post.description:
Sign in. An account deleted less than the grace period ago answers 409
`account_pending_deletion` (with `deletion_scheduled_at`) until the learner sends
`restore: true`, which cancels the deletion (#120).

schema.title: Response Restore Api V1 Auth Oidc Google Restore Post

get.description:
Start Google sign-in. A new account is created only when the flow carries the
current terms and privacy versions the learner accepted (#104); without them the
callback refuses with reason `consent` and creates nothing.

post.description: Email a reset link. The answer is the same whether or not the email has an account.
Set a new password with the token from the email; signs the learner out everywhere.

Create an account. The learner must accept the current terms and privacy
versions: 422 `consent_required` without them, 409 `consent_version_changed` when
they changed meanwhile (#104).

Submit the three-sentence gist after the whole passage has played (FR-BL-4, #65).

Completes the Blind step. An `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry return the first answer.

Report the player's position every 5 s (FR-BL-3, System Design 9.2).

The answer is `continue`, `resume` (the one resume after an interruption the
learner did not cause, D13 and D18) or `stop` with the attempt's `void_reason`.

get.description:
The passage's audio for this attempt only (#62). Range requests go to storage.

The token in the path comes from starting the attempt; the redirect's signed URL
lives only until the attempt's window ends.

307.description: Redirect to a signed storage URL that ends with the attempt

410.description: `media_expired`: the attempt ended or its window is over

post.description:
The page reports leaving, a reload or a seek: the listen ends (FR-BL-3).

Sent with `fetch(..., {keepalive: true})` from `pagehide` and `visibilitychange`.
After the whole passage has played it changes nothing.

get.description: The learner's content items, newest first, in keyset pages.

post.description:
Confirm an upload: the file must be in storage with the declared size.

Creates a pending content item and queues its conversion, or keeps it in the
learner's own queue while two of theirs are being prepared. Refused with 429
`daily_audio_limit` once today's new audio is used up. Confirming the same upload
again returns the same item with 200; an `Idempotency-Key` replays the first
response exactly.

get.description:
One of the learner's items: its processing status, or why it failed, and where
to play it once it is playable.

410.description: Removed as a copy of a clip the learner already has (`duplicate_upload`, with `existing_content_id` and `existing_title`)

get.description:
The attempt's state and, once scored, the diff and accuracy (FR-DI-5).

The reference text is in `result.items` only. Before scoring it is in no answer
of the Dictation routes (FR-DI-3, FR-TX-5). Refetch it when `dictation.scored`
arrives on the event stream.

put.description:
Save the Dictation draft if it is still at `draft_version` (FR-DI-4, #50).

A save based on an older version gets 409 `draft_conflict`, so two tabs never
silently overwrite each other; resending a save that already landed succeeds.

post.description:
Record the attempt's first successful playback for the time-to-listen metric.

Repeated calls are idempotent. Opening the Dictation screen alone records nothing.

get.description: The marks of the attempt's session in audio order, to show the words already added.

post.description:
Add missed or wrong words of the scored diff to the mark list (FR-DI-6).

Each entry is a word or a run of words next to each other that were all missed or
wrong, at most 20. The answer has one mark per entry, in order: words that are already
marked give back the mark they have and a resend gives back the same mark, so adding
twice never makes a duplicate. The browser-made `id` is the idempotency key, so no
`Idempotency-Key` is needed (ADR 0047). One refused entry refuses the request.

Submit the text, finish the attempt and complete the Dictation step (FR-DI-5).

The score is not in this answer: it is computed when the transcript is ready and
announced by the `dictation.scored` event. An `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry
return the first answer.

get.description:
Stream the learner's live events (System Design 9.1).

Each event carries only its type and the id of the resource to refetch.

200.description: A Server-Sent Events stream of the learner's events: job.progress, content.ready, transcript.ready, transcript.failed, grade.ready, dictation.scored, attempt.voided, export.ready, account.disabled (the stream then ends) and resync.

get.description: D4: details are absent until Transcript opens when Dictation follows.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: The learner's library, newest first, 20 per page by default (FR-LB-1).

304.description: Not modified since the ETag in If-None-Match

delete.description:
Delete the account (FR-ACC-4, DR-1, D9; ADR 0029).

The account is disabled at once and every login session ends. Everything is
deleted when the grace period ends, unless the learner signs in and restores the
account before then.

get.description: The learner's consents for the settings page (#104).

post.description:
Accept the current version of a document (#104): a changed terms or privacy
policy on sign-in, or voice recording before Shadow. A version that is not current
answers 409 `consent_version_changed`. Granting again changes nothing.

Withdraw voice-recording consent (FR-SH-17): sets `withdrawn_at`, and new Shadow
rounds are refused until the learner agrees again. Terms and privacy answer 409
`consent_not_withdrawable`.

get.description: Counts for the review step before account deletion (UX-06).

post.description:
Start a copy of all the learner's data: a ZIP with data.json and their uploaded
media. It is built in the background; `export.ready` tells the browser when it is
ready or has failed. YouTube media files are not included (D10).

409.description: An export is already being prepared (`export_in_progress`)

get.description: The learner's most recent export and its status; `export` is null if none.

Download the archive. Needs the owner's session; the link it redirects to works
for a short time only.

307.description: Redirect to a short-lived signed link of the archive

get.description:
The playback file. Redirects to a signed storage URL that serves range requests,
so the player starts on the first bytes and seeks without downloading everything.

307.description: Redirect to a short-lived signed storage URL

404.description: No item of yours uses this media object

409.description: Not playable yet (`media_not_ready`) or blocked by an unfinished Blind listen (`blind_in_progress`)

get.description: The waveform peaks: JSON with `per_second` values a second on a 0 to `scale` range.

307.description: Redirect to a short-lived signed storage URL

404.description: No item of yours uses this media object

409.description: Not playable yet (`media_not_ready`) or blocked by an unfinished Blind listen (`blind_in_progress`)

get.description: The learner's sessions, most recently active first, in keyset pages.

post.description:
Start a plan on a clip from the library, with its first step open (FR-PL-1, FR-LB-2).

The clip must be playable, and the passage 30 s to 15 min long and within the clip.
An `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry return the first session instead of a second one.

409.description: `content_not_ready`: the clip cannot be played yet

get.description: One session with its plan: steps, the open step and the entry lock.
The Blind step with its newest attempt, so a reloaded page knows where it stands.

post.description:
Start one listen of the passage (FR-BL-1, #62).

Returns a media URL bound to this attempt. The player sends a heartbeat every
`heartbeat_interval_ms` from now on.

get.description:
The session's newest Dictation attempt with its score, after the step is complete.

The Dictation result stays on the session page while the plan moves on to Transcript.

post.description:
Start the Dictation attempt (201), or resume the one in progress with its draft
(200). Leaving or reloading never voids a Dictation attempt (FR-PL-6, NFR-REL-1).

The answer holds what the player needs, the passage and the media path, and never
any reference text (FR-DI-3, FR-TX-5).

patch.description:
Change Blind, Dictation or both until Transcript opens (FR-PL-5, SR-3).

The unfinished steps are rebuilt; a finished entry exercise stays and cannot be
removed. Choosing the current entry again changes nothing.

get.description: The session's marks in audio order (NFR-REL-1: they come back after a reload).

post.description:
Mark a word or phrase (FR-TR-2). The browser names the mark with a new id, so
a create resent after a lost connection answers 200 with the stored mark instead
of making a second one (ADR 0047). The server sets the audio time from the words.

delete.description: Remove the mark. A second removal answers 404 `mark_not_found`.

patch.description: Replace the mark's note; an empty or null note removes it.

put.description:
Confirm a mark pre-filled from Dictation (FR-TR-3). Confirming again answers with
the same mark, so a resend is harmless; to drop the mark, DELETE it (ADR 0058).

get.description: Resume the saved selection, proposing one on first entry.

post.description:
Skip Card or Shadow after the learner confirmed (FR-PL-7, SR-4).

Skipping Shadow completes the session, whatever happened to Card (SR-6, D12).

Finish Transcript and unlock Card (FR-PL-4). No marks are required.

An Idempotency-Key replays completion without advancing the next step.

Check the declared file and return a signed URL to PUT it straight to storage.

Refused before any byte is sent: an unsupported type (`unsupported_file_type`), a
file over the size limit (`file_too_large`), one that would take the account over
its storage cap (`storage_full`), or any new clip once today's new audio is used up
(429 `daily_audio_limit`, with `resets_at`). Rate-limited per learner and per IP.

get.description:
How much of the per-account upload storage is used, the per-file limit (D5), and
today's allowance of new audio (D16).

delete.description: Forget an upload that was cancelled before it was added to the library.
